text.jp:
ヒヒヒッ。命知らずもいたものだねえ……
“地獄の道化師”と共に戦いたいだなんて。
text.official_en:
You wanna join up with the Infernal Clown, huh?
So braaave!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ボクは気まぐれなんだ。
突然後ろから刺されても知らないよ？
text.official_en:
I'm not to be trusted, you know. Might turn around
and stab you in the back.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ヒーッハハハハハ！
ならお望みどおり、オマエの近くにいてやるよ！
text.official_en: Heh heh HEH! You want me, you got me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
血だまりの上で仲良く、
死ぬまで踊り狂おうじゃあないか！
text.official_en:
Let's make a nice big pool of blood—and then go
swimming in it!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム

text.jp:
ケヒヒヒ……怖気づいたかい？
でもそれが賢明さ。
text.official_en: Heh heh... What, scared of me? Good. You should be.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ヒャハハ！　傑作だね！
この“地獄のジェスター”を仲間に誘うなんてさ！
text.official_en:
Heh heh. You got the right idea, looking to have the
Infernal Clown on your side.
text.real_en:
Heh heh. You got the right idea, looking to have the
Jester of Hell on your side.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
愉快な気持ちの礼に、何もしないであげるよ。
斬り刻まれたくなったら、またおいで。
text.official_en:
And in return? I won't do anything to you. You ever
feel like getting chopped to bits, come on by.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
“地獄の道化師”と共に戦いたいだなんて。
命知らずもいたものだねえ……
text.official_en:
You wanna join up with the Infernal Clown, huh?
Must be pretty brave.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム

text.jp:
ボクは気まぐれなんだ。
突然後ろから刺されても知らないよ？
text.official_en:
Be warned—I'm the fickle type. I might join your
side today, stab ya in the back tomorrow!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
へえ……それでもいいのかい？
ヒヒヒッ！　気に入ったよ！
text.official_en: You're that sure, huh? Heh HEH! I like that.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
けど、残念ながら、オマエからは
ベルトランほどの血の匂いを感じないね。
text.official_en:
But no, Bertrand's got death on him. I smell it. And I
don't smell it on you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そんな相手に、ボクの心はなびかないよ……
そうだ！　おすすめの相手を教えてあげる。
text.official_en:
So you ain't winning me over... Well, not unless you
get a little more death on ya.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム

text.jp:
帝都の南の「ダダ平原」を根城にしている
「ベイル血殲衆」って一味が残忍な連中でね。
text.official_en:
You hear of the Bale Lacerators? Nasty bunch.
Holed up in the Dada plains south of the capital.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
近くの村人が討伐に行ったんだが
誰が誰かわからないくらい刻まれちまったって噂さ！
text.official_en:
Some villagers went to hunt them down and wound
up getting themselves carved up something fierce.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その連中と血まみれの戦いを繰り広げてきなよ。
仲間になる話はそうしたらまた考えてあげる。
text.official_en:
So! Go give 'em a fight, the sickos. Then maybe I'll
think about joining your little crew.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
「ベイル血殲衆」を倒したのかい？
へえ……思ったよりやるじゃないか……
text.official_en:
Did you beat the Bale Lacerators? Wow.
You're better than I thought.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いや、オマエたちに倒されるなんて
奴らが噂ほどじゃなかったってことかな？
text.official_en:
If you and your buddies could do that, I guess they
weren't all that tough.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
クックック！　少しは血の匂いがしてきたね、
でも、まだまだ物足りないな。
text.official_en: Heh HEH! I smell the blood, but it's not enough.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
つねに死臭を漂わせるくらいじゃなきゃ
ボクの気は引けないよ。
text.official_en:
You really wanna get my attention, you'll need more
death on you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ちょうどいい相手がいる。「セドー砦」に
陣取る山賊「屍獄のデュナンゾ」の奴らさ。
text.official_en:
Tell ya what. Go to Fort Theed. There's a bandit
gang there called the Corpse-Gaol Dunanzo.
text.real_en:
Tell ya what. Go to Sedo Fort. There's a bandit
gang there called the Corpse-Gaol Dunanzo.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ちょうどいい相手がいる。「ワルハラ鉱山」に
陣取る山賊「屍獄のデュナンゾ」の奴らさ。
text.official_en:
Head to the Valhalla Mine. The bandit gang
Corpse-Gaol Dunanzo is stationed there.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
奴らに狙われ、さらわれた人間は帰ってこない。
アジトには白骨がゴロゴロ。死の匂いでいっぱいさ。
text.official_en:
They kidnap people—and their victims never come
back. So that hideout, it's littered with skeletons.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そこでそいつらと、一戦交えてみなよ。
仲間になるって話はその後考えるからさ。
text.official_en:
Go and give 'em a fight. Then we'll talk about
joining up.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

え？　「屍獄のデュナンゾ」を殲滅した！？
あの連中を？　そ、そいつは凄いね……
text.official_en:
Huh? You wiped out Corpse-Gaol Dunanzo?!
How'd ya pull that off?!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
死臭が漂ってくるようになったかって？
そうだな……まあ、及第かな。
text.official_en:
If you smell like death? Ehhh... I guess you smell
enough like it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
オマエ……奴らを倒せて安心した顔をしてるね？
でも、そんな気になるのはまだ早いよ。
text.official_en:
You look all proud of yourself to have beaten 'em.
But don't get ahead of yourself, now.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
「囁き岩」にいる、その名も
「冥府の彷徨団」を倒してきなよ。
text.official_en:
The Underworld Wanderers at Whispering Rock.
Defeat them and come back to me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム

text.jp:
こいつらはあらゆる極悪非道な輩の集まりで
まさに冥府からの使者と呼ぶに相応しい。
text.official_en:
That bunch is a who's who of scumbags. People call
'em the couriers of the underworld.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム
US EN person identifier agrees

ボクを仲間にしたければ行っておいで。でも、
諦めたほうが身のためさ。命が惜しいならね。
text.official_en:
If you want to get me on your side—head there.
You want to live... Maybe don't.

text.official_en: <TH>

め……「冥府の彷徨団」も倒した！？
う、嘘じゃあないみたいだね……
text.official_en:
You're saying you beat the Underworld Wanderers?!
And...it doesn't look like you're lying.

ひっひっひ！　オマエたちは、血の海を渡り
死者の山を越え、冥府を覗いたみたいだね！
text.official_en:
Heh HEH! You swam a sea of blood, climbed a
mountain of corpses—even saw the underworld!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マクシム

text.jp:
でも、真の地獄を見るのはこれからさ。
なにせ、ボクが隣にいるんだからね？
text.official_en: And now you'll know true hell, because I'll be there.

このジェスターを仲間へ引き入れたこと
後悔させてあげるよ。キーハッハッハッハ！
text.official_en: Regretting this yet? Heh heh HEH!
